chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Safwan al-Jammal, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) used to pray the night prayer during the day while mounted on his mount, wherever it faced.
ai.seo_question: Can the night prayer be performed during the day while riding?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) practice of performing Salat al-Layl during the day while riding, illustrating the permissibility of offering voluntary prayers in a seated position during travel. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that the spiritual merit of night prayer is not strictly bound to the night hours when circumstances, such as travel, necessitate flexibility in posture and timing.
